acts: AIFC Data Protection Regulations and Rules

en.title: DP Rules r.4.2.3(a): first notification due 'no later than 14 days start of the operations' - before or after the start is not said
en.summary: Rule 4.2.3(a) requires the notification of Personal Data Processing operations 'no later than 14 days start of the operations' - a word ('after' or 'before') is missing, so the deadline can be read as 14 days before the operations start or 14 days after. The neighbouring r.4.3 uses the full form 'no later than 14 days after the day the particulars change'. Text unchanged since the 2018 Rules; the notification attracts the item 3 fee (USD 1,000/500/200).
en.correction: Please state whether the first notification is due 14 days before or 14 days after the start of the operations (rule 4.3 uses "after the day").
